note2026_08_17f_s02_real_runtime_refusal: Follow-up task after note2026_08_17e's fix reportedly still failed against the ACTUAL interactive runtime (npx tsx scripts/run-local-session.ts tbct-s02 --interactive). Root cause, confirmed by tracing submitPatientInput directly (not just unit-testing isExplicitPatientRefusal in isolation): the previous fix's negative-lookbehind regex only blocked the false positive when the target object's particle sat DIRECTLY adjacent to '그만' ('습관을 그만'); real phrasing routinely separates them into two clauses ('머리카락 만지는 습관이 있는데 그만하고싶어요' names '습관' several words earlier, no particle immediately before '그만'), so the lookbehind never fired. Replaced with a deliberately conservative design: bare '그만...' (no session noun present) now only counts as refusal when it is the START of the message (optionally after a short subject/filler word), never after a named target anywhere in the sentence -- verified against both the original P0-1 corpus AND the newly-reported real sentence (4 spacing variants) via a NEW test describe block that drives the exact reported string through submitPatientInput (src/lib/protocol/sessions/s02.test.ts's 'real interactive-runtime reproduction' block), not just the detector function. Also hardened assessment-providers.ts's systemInstruction() (used by cloud assessment providers only -- confirmed the default 'deterministic' provider's DeterministicAssessmentModel never returns intent='refusal' at all, so this wasn't the actual bug here, but the user explicitly asked this path be checked/hardened too) with an explicit REFUSAL section distinguishing session-refusal from generic problem/goal content that happens to contain 'stop'/그만/멈추다. CCPH/CCGH scale UX pass (separate goal, same task): six-anchor-problem-scale/discomfort-distress-distinction/six-anchor-goal-scale moved from static APPROVED_TEXT/koreanText maps to computed branches in static-messages/s02.ts's resolveStaticText (content now depends on problemScaleCardAvailable/goalScaleCardAvailable, which a static string can't express) -- rewritten as: why-we-rate framing, six anchors as individually readable '0점, 연한 파란색: ...' lines (not a semicolon-packed dump), explicit numeric-or-color framing, 0-3/4-5 discomfort-distress split with a comprehension-check question, and (goal scale) explicit 'same colors, different meaning' framing -- all per the task brief's exact required content. 'No rating card' (rating-card-check/goal-rating-card-check answered 아니요) now prefixes the scale explanation with an explicit 'that's fine, I'll walk you through it' acknowledgment instead of silently moving on (the underlying step sequencing already never blocked on card absence -- verified via trace -- this only fixes the WORDING acknowledging it). Found and fixed two bugs surfaced while implementing this: (1) deliverProcessClarificationTurn (added in note2026_08_17e) resolved its 're-show the current question' text from the compiled RuntimePromptItem.fallbackPatientText instead of the session's live static-message resolver, so any prompt whose wording is entirely computed (the new scale prompts, and pre-existing ones like reflect-problem-score/problem-total) showed a generic placeholder instead of its real content during a process-clarification turn -- fixed by preferring resolveStaticPatientMessage(promptItem, locale, runtimeContext) with the old behavior as fallback; (2) elicit-problems/elicit-goals' follow-up prompts (problem-avoidance, goal-life-change, etc.) had no activationCondition on problemsNoMore/goalsNoMore, so saying '더 생각나는 건 없어요' correctly set the NoMore flag (note2026_08_17e's P0-2 fix) but did nothing to stop four more 'anything else?' follow-ups from still firing -- added activationCondition: {field: '<list>NoMore', operator: 'not_equals', value: true} to each elicitation follow-up (not to goal-dream-small-step, which elaborates on an already-named goal rather than eliciting a new one, and correctly keeps firing). Also implemented the section-13 known blocker: private_placeholder_labels (offer-private-placeholders) had no deterministic parser at all (every answer, including '아니요', was stored as the raw sentence) and privateProblemAdded (the flag acknowledge-private-placeholder/continue-without-placeholder branch on) was permanently dead -- added a parser in runtime-context.ts's storage switch that extracts X/Y/Z letters, sets privateProblemAdded accordingly, and appends named letters to `problems` for later rating (per the source manual's 'track it alongside the others'). Added a narrow scale-comprehension uncertainty detector ('잘 모르겠어요', '색깔이 무슨 뜻이에요?', 'N점이랑 M점이 뭐가 달라요?') SCOPED to only the discomfort-distress-distinction prompt id (not the general-purpose looksLikeMeaningClarificationRequest used across all S01-S03 prompts, since '잘 모르겠어요' is a genuine acceptable uncertain answer elsewhere per FIELDS_ACCEPTING_UNCERTAINTY) -- routes through the existing P0-5 process-clarification mechanism (no clarificationAttemptCount increment, same prompt retained). Also fixed scripts/run-local-session.ts (local dev tool, not session content): node:readline's Interface auto-closes once its non-TTY input stream reaches EOF, and this script's async session-setup work before the loop's first question() call was enough time for a piped stdin to hit EOF and close the interface before anything ever asked it a question -- silently returning undefined (node:readline/promises) or throwing ERR_USE_AFTER_CLOSE (callback node:readline), verified by isolating the exact Node v24.19.0 behavior with minimal repros. Fixed by detecting non-TTY stdin (process.stdin.isTTY) and pre-reading all piped lines into a plain in-memory queue up front, dispensed one per turn -- immune to the interface's own EOF/close timing; a real terminal keeps the original live question()-per-turn behavior unchanged. This is what made `npx tsx scripts/run-local-session.ts tbct-s02 --interactive` (piped) actually runnable for the required manual verification, and was verified against the literal exact reported failing utterance end-to-end (transcript in the final report).
note2026_08_17h_s02_confirmation_and_rat: Narrow follow-up: two manual-control failures found in real S02 testing, explicitly scoped by the task brief to exactly these two fixes (no S01/S03/dialogue-agent/safety changes, no broad refactor). (1) problem-confirmation ('Got it -- I'll add that to your list.') and acknowledge-private-placeholder ('Thank you for letting me know it's there...') are passive acknowledgments with no question in them, but promptItem.type 'confirmation' is unconditionally forced requiresPatientInput=true in runtime-release-normalizer.ts's promptRequiresPatientInput regardless of outputFields -- so a plain '네' after either was rejected as filler and re-asked with the generic 'give a short concrete example' clarification (problem-confirmation), or a private-placeholder answer meant for the NEXT prompt (rating-card-check) got consumed by acknowledge-private-placeholder instead, leaving rating-card-check unanswered (found while running the task's own required final-verification scenario, which adds an X placeholder). Fixed via a new exact-id exception set, PASSIVE_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_PROMPT_IDS, extending the SAME pattern the codebase already used for tbct-s02-n11-p02-recorded-summary (an existing exact-id carve-out in the same function) -- not a change to the 'confirmation' type rule itself, so S03's redirection-contract/confirm-working-thought (real yes/no questions, type confirmation) and every other session's confirmation-typed prompts are provably unaffected (full suite + 8-session simulated audit still pass byte-for-byte). Also removed problem-confirmation's now-meaningless outputFields: ['problems'] in s02.ts (it never legitimately produces a NEW problems entry -- the entry it's acknowledging was already written by the preceding prompt). (2) problemScaleCardAvailable/goalScaleCardAvailable (rating-card-check/goal-rating-card-check, both already validation.kind: 'boolean' from the prior pass) rejected any answer not an EXACT match against the shared BOOLEAN_ANSWER_TEXT set/parseBooleanInput (runtime-deterministic-input.ts, untouched) -- so '아니요 설명해주세요' or '없는데 설명해주세요' (trailing content) and '있어요'/'가지고 있어요' (a natural 'have/don't have' answer to this specific question, never in the generic yes/no vocabulary at all) all failed and fell through to the generic clarification, eventually pausing the session. Fixed with a new parseCardAvailabilityAnswer in runtime-context.ts, scoped by field name (CARD_AVAILABILITY_FIELDS = {problemScaleCardAvailable, goalScaleCardAvailable}) and applied as a strictly ADDITIVE fallback -- the shared parser is tried FIRST and always wins when it succeeds (verified this ordering explicitly after an initial version that swapped the parsers outright broke the simulated-patient-runner audit's English-language synthetic answers for these same two fields); the field-scoped extension only ever fires when the shared parser fails. Same pattern applied to isMeaningfulTextResponse's existing boolean branch (an added field-scoped OR-clause, not a replacement). BOOLEAN_ANSWER_TEXT/parseBooleanInput/parseDeterministicPromptInput are byte-for-byte unchanged, so every other boolean-kind prompt in every session keeps its exact prior behavior -- confirmed via full suite (397/397) + 8-session simulated audit + the required interactive reproduction (npx tsx scripts/run-local-session.ts tbct-s02 --interactive, using the run-local-session.ts stdin fix from note2026_08_17f) run against the task's own literal final-verification scenario end to end.
